subject: SOURCE-COMPUTER paragraph
notes: Rule: 'When the SOURCE-COMPUTER paragraph is not specified and the source unit is not contained within a source unit including a SOURCE-COMPUTER paragraph, the computer on which the source unit is being compiled is the source computer.' (cite.py --check 12.3.5.4 -> OK §12.3.5.4 2)). The paragraph is optional in the grammar and the compiler has no source-computer-dependent behavior: no code consumes a source-computer identity (grep of src for computerName() finds only the OBJECT-COMPUTER gate at VersionConformancePass.cs:1468), so the source computer is always the compiling host — exactly the rule. The only paragraph-derived state (DebuggingModeDeclared) defaults to false when the paragraph is absent, which is the no-clause behavior. No dedicated spec-derived test; every golden omitting the paragraph exercises it implicitly. [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023]
